new_destinations.name: Changzhou
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage article "Changzhou": "a city of 3.6 million people ... those with a bit of time can spend a pleasant ..." (guidebook city with See/Do listings; the city tourist site lists the AAAA spots).

spots.name: Tianning Temple
spots.bio_draft: Buddhist temple beside the Grand Canal and Hongmei Park, with the 13-storey Tianning Pagoda.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 1.6 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: China Dinosaur Park
spots.bio_draft: Theme park in Xinbei with rides, a dinosaur museum and a hot spring area.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 6.5 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: Chunqiu Yancheng
spots.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 631156663 (leisure=park, 春秋淹城遗址公园)
spots.bio_draft: Rebuilt Spring and Autumn period Yancheng city ruins with three concentric moats and a museum.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 9.2 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: Hongmei Park
spots.bio_draft: Red Plum Park, one of Changzhou's largest parks, with lakes, pavilions and the Writing Pagoda.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 1.8 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.
spots.pin_note: source point is a park/lake centroid or area; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point

spots.name: Dongpo Park
spots.bio_draft: Park on a Grand Canal islet with a Dongpo academy hall, a statue of the Song poet and a Qianlong-era palace site.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 2.6 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: Canal 5 Creative Campus
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Changzhou listing geo tag (Canal 5, 141 Sanbao St)
spots.bio_draft: Former textile mill on the Grand Canal turned into studios, cafes and galleries.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 1.9 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: Changzhou Museum
spots.bio_draft: Municipal museum on Civic Square with relics, a children's natural history museum and free entry.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 3.4 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: Yancheng Safari Park
spots.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 631156662 (tourism=zoo, 江苏淹城野生动物世界)
spots.bio_draft: Drive-through and walk-through safari park in Wujin with animals in enclosures.
spots.reason: Changzhou city (Tianning, Zhonglou, Xinbei, Wujin), 9.5 km from the centre, inside the 30 km span.

spots.name: Tianmu Lake
spots.bio_draft: Large reservoir lake in Liyang on the Jiangsu-Anhui-Zhejiang border, with boat trips and lakeside walks.
spots.reason: Liyang is a separate county-level city of Changzhou, 58 km from Changzhou's centre, far outside its span; 33 km from Yixing's centre but across the municipal line and not in its Wikivoyage article. Two kept Liyang spots, below the four-spot bar.
spots.pin_note: source point is a park/lake centroid or area; resolve-pin.py must find the visitor point

spots.name: Nanshan Bamboo Sea
spots.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way 334129131 (leisure=nature_reserve, 南山竹海景区)
spots.bio_draft: South Hill Bamboo Sea in Liyang, 35,000 mu of bamboo with a ground rail, lakes and a bamboo culture park.
spots.reason: Liyang, as for Tianmu Lake; 28 km from Yixing's centre but a different county-level city, and not Yixing's Bamboo Sea.
